independent_comparison.finding: This concurrently-created variant already binds policy-relevant fields into the hash and requires authenticated-user authority for privileged preauthorization and confirmation application. It is therefore safer on EA-CEX-01..05, but it still requires contract-level review for DELETE_ACCOUNT warning semantics, MASS_DELETE rollback semantics, and persistent nonce/restart integration.

repair_requirements: Canonicalize to exactly one H1 effect-authority implementation.
Bind every policy-relevant request field into ConfirmationReceipt request identity; exclude only explicitly non-authoritative cognition/salience hints.
Require independently valid authenticated/scoped authority for privileged exact preauthorization.
Require AUTHENTICATED_USER plus authenticated request state for user confirmation receipts; SELF_PROPOSAL_ONLY remains proposal-only.
Add EA-CEX-01..05 as permanent regression tests.
Integrate consumed confirmation nonce/idempotency state with H-WP-02 canonical state ledger and test crash/restart replay.
Run target-VPS and full-H1 pipeline tests before promotion.
